The WARN-demotion license is adequately fenced against the "silent weak-artifact reuse / gate-skipping" reading, on four independent clauses: (1) lattice cell (i) makes structural/multiplicative apply-path breakage HALT "always — this precedence is absolute and no WARN license overrides it"; (2) mid-run demotion requires ALL THREE of (a) independent apply-path confirmation / (b) persisted value / (c) named analyzer adjudication + discriminating test, with the explicit backstop "a run that cannot produce (a) when demoting does not demote: it stays halted"; (3) every WARN gate, fresh or demoted, binds (b)+(c), so nothing is ever silent; (4) the anti-skip clause names a skip flag with no demotion record "a silent gate deletion".
